Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is transforming the future of communications and digital identity. Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world’s largest companies and emerging brands. Our unrivaled global reach empowers businesses to create engaging experiences with built-in fraud protection across the entire customer lifecycle.

Our comprehensive suite of solutions – from our super network for voice, messaging, and data, to 5G and IoT; and from verification and intelligence to CPaaS for personalized omnichannel engagement – enables businesses and communities to thrive. Reaching over 5 billion subscribers, securing more than 180 billion transactions annually, and connecting 1,000+ destinations, we honor our commitment to connect, protect and engage everyone, everywhere.

Key highlights include:

• Powering over 13 billion digital communications each month
• Supporting 3,500+ active customers — including enterprises, OTTs, and mobile operators — through a presence in 50+ global offices across 100+ countries
• Managing 50% of the world’s roaming data traffic and connecting 150 million IoT devices
• Driving innovation in 5G, private networks, and IoT enablement, positioning Proximus Global as a leader in next-generation communication technologies
• Committed to a unified vision, Proximus Global is unlocking new opportunities and enabling seamless global communications for businesses worldwide
Please note that this position is based in Brussels and offered as a permanent contract (CDI). It is not a freelance opportunity. The role requires on-site presence 2 to 3 days per week.

Job Title: Business Analyst - IT (Voice & Cloud Communication) 
Location: Brussels, Belgium 
Department: Application and Solution Development 

Role Overview 
 

As a Business Analyst IT, you will play a pivotal role in bridging business needs with technical solutions. You will be responsible for gathering and analyzing requirements, designing solutions, and supporting Agile development teams to deliver high-impact functionalities for BICS Voice and Cloud Communication services as part of Proximus Global. 
 

Key Responsibilities 

• Building and maintaining a strong and trustful relationship with our stakeholders via solid communication and close collaboration. 
• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and problem definitions, translating them into system requirements. 
• Prioritize and maintain the product backlog with the support of the Product Owner in a continuous collaborative mode. 
• Conduct meetings and closely collaborate with business community, end-users, platform owners, engineers, architects, developers, QA teams, process manager and external partners to shape and deliver effective business solutions. 
• Determine the detailed specifications required to develop and improve the business applications.  
• Achieve consensus by reconciling business needs, technical/security/legal constraints and architecture principles. 
• Ensure accurate and evolving effort estimations from project inception through detailed design and backlog management, enabling realistic planning and resource allocation. 
• Producing and maintaining comprehensive solution documentation artefacts (user stories, functiona

Your Profile 

• Solid IT background with minimum 3-5 years as business/functional analyst.  
• Strong analytical abilities with problem-solving and results-oriented mindset. 
• Proven practice of Scrum development methodologies, ceremonies and related tools. 
• Familiar with requirements gathering and development cost estimation techniques. 
• Ability to lead meetings, achieve compromises and articulate complex solutions to both business and technical audiences. 
• Aptitude to challenge status-quo and be innovative in solution definition. 
• Fluent in English with excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills.  
• Self-driven and autonomous, consistently applying an agile and value-driven approach to software development. 
• Learning and adapting quickly to new domain knowledge and technologies. 
 
Preferred Qualifications 

• Knowledge about cloud communication and voice carrier related services and technologies. Familiarity with BSS/OSS systems and service orchestration. 
• Experience in an international business environment and with distributed teams. 
• Practice of data modeling, data mining techniques and tooling (SQL, ERD,…). 
• Experience in designing application interfaces and API’s contracts.

Your Role and responsibilities
 

We are looking for an Information Security Consultant to join our Security Strategy & Advisory business unit.

 

You will be part of a diversified team with all levels of seniority. You will integrate your field of action within a more global cybersecurity approach. Therefore, you will also benefit from the experience of our 100 experts to teach you the needed skills and make your career take off.

If you want to take a role in a human centric company who put efforts in developing its collaborators, there is a place for you here. Thanks to our Cyber Academy and the support of your own Career Counsellor, Approach puts your skills’ growth at the center of its activities.

As a pure player in cyber security, we take the position of a strategical partner to help our clients securing their information, while providing our consultants many varied opportunities across the whole security roadmap.

Through this wide perspective, our Information Security Consultants advise our customers on how to improve their cybersecurity maturity and resilience. We assist our clients during the whole security journey, from assessing the current state, to proposing security improvements and managing implementation and changes.

Concretely, as an Information Security Consultant, you could:

• Provide high value services to customers in the light of Approach’s Information security offering/business:
• Perform security and risk assessment at client (e.g. perform our ACAM® (Approach Cybersecurity Assessment Methodology) to evaluate their cybersecurity maturity.
• Implemente information security management systems (ISMS), governance, risk management, based on regulations and standards.
• Be the driver of change to manage, coordinate or pilot security projects in line with the decisions.
• Propose security improvements, define priorities and create security roadmaps to follow.
• Accompany your client through the change management process.
• Develop and implement plans to anticipate, address, and mitigate the effects of various business interruptions
• Provide CISO or assistant-CISO services to our customers (i.e. provide strategic and technical advise, organizing the information security related activities, supporting customers to manage security incident(s), …)

Use your energy, your proactivity, and your smile to make our Security Strategy & Advisory business unit grow by (i.e.):

• Actively contributing to the development of tools and methodologies used by your team.
• Sharing your knowledge about topic news to your team (e.g. market needs, trends, technology evolutions that impact information security, …)
• Contributing to develop a business/commercial approach towards potential customers.
• 
Following and coaching junior colleagues.

 

Your profile
 

You have:

• A first relevant experience in Information/IT Security in a similar function
• Knowledge of regulatory and/or sector specific standards and frameworks (e.g. ISO27000, NIS2, DORA, SOC2, CIS Critical Security Controls, ...)
• Ability to understand senior management considerations (strategic level) and ability to help them in their decision.
• English and Dutch is a must have. Bilingual (FR/NL) is a plus.

Considered as a plus:

 

• Recognized Information Security certifications like ISO27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, ISO27005, EBIOS, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, COBIT, ITIL, CCSK
• Exposure to ISMS operation or implementation, cloud security projects, Third-Party risk management projects, business continuity plan (BCP) or disaster recovery plan (DRP), security assessments, security incidents, crisis management, awareness activities, …

Mindset :

 

• Willingness to provide high quality deliverables and to go the extra mile.
• True communicator with Business level communication skills: to talk and negotiate with different customers’ stakeholders at both technical and business level; to lead a security project and be able to explain it to technical and non-technical audience; to perform trainings and conduct meetings with customers’ stakeholders
• Project oriented by being dedicated to the client’s objectives and give advice.
• Teamplayer
• Manage diverse workloads and prioritize accordingly.
• Uncompromised integrity: respect for the confidentiality of both client and company information
• Ambassador for the professional values that are at the heart of our philosophy:
TOP-NOTCH
HUMAN-CENTRIC
NO-NONSENSE

The Financial Services market is a key priority for Sopra Steria. This sector encompasses a robust client portfolio, including leading banks, insurance companies, social secretaries, and mutuality companies. Financial Services is also a focal point for our Consulting activities, offering substantial growth opportunities as our clients navigate diverse stages of their digital transformation journeys. 

As part of the Consulting Business Line at Sopra Steria, you will play a pivotal role within the Financial Services Community. Collaborating with a network of peers, you will contribute to or lead efforts such as crafting proposals, developing service offerings, sharing industry insights, and driving internal projects. 

Your primary focus will be client engagements, which will constitute the majority of your time. These engagements may involve working as part of high-performing teams embedded within client organizations or contributing to Sopra Steria’s fixed-price Consulting projects within multidisciplinary teams. 

As a Senior Consultant or Manager, you will take ownership of complex assignments, manage client relationships, develop and apply managerial skills, and support business development activities. Leveraging on your industry expertise, your responsibilities on specific projects may include project and change management, Agile/Scrum facilitation, business and functional analysis, or architectural design

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:   

Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience in Consulting, working with clients in the Financial Services industry.

Industry Knowledge: strong understanding of business processes in one or more of the following sectors: large banks, insurance companies, social security organizations, and/or mutuality companies.

Digital Transformation: demonstrated experience in contributing to or leading digital transformation initiatives for clients, combining deep industry knowledge with a strong affinity for digitalization and IT.

Areas of Expertise: demonstrated skills in one or more of the following domains: IT Advisory (Target Operating Models), Project Management, Business/Functional Analysis, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Architectural Design, ESG, or Product Management. 

Additional Knowledge: familiarity with topics such as Open Finance, Instant Payments, AI in Financial Services, ESG, or cloud migration strategies are a plus.

Certifications: recognized certifications such as Prince2, TOGAF/Archimate, Leading SAFe, or Lean Six Sigma are advantageous. 

Consulting Mindset: strong ability to build and maintain trustworthy client relationships, familiarity with business development approaches, and a strong connection to the Consulting "motherhouse".

Languages: fluency in English and either French or Dutch is required.

Are you a technically skilled engineer with a passion for pharmaceutical processes? As a Project Engineer, you will contribute to various engineering projects. You’ll be responsible for the full project lifecycle of specific installations or equipment: from specification and procurement to installation, validation, and handover to operations. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams, monitor planning and budget, and ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution. You’ll also be part of creating technical solutions and be included in the technical follow-up with suppliers. At Terumo, we advance lifesaving medical technologies to benefit society. Are you eager to make a difference with us? Here, you'll grow your expertise while staying true to your personal aspirations.

Guided by our Japanese heritage, we act with respect, take ownership, and pursue continuous improvement. If you see yourself in our values, keep reading; this might be the opportunity you're looking for.
Department Info

Terumo is a global manufacturer of medical devices, with a strong production footprint in Leuven, where approximately 800 million hypodermic needles and injection solutions are produced annually.  Within the Pharmaceutical Solutions department, we focus on highly customized products developed according to the specific needs, medicines and questions of our pharmaceutical customers. To enable this high level of personalization, Terumo has invested heavily in flexible, highly automated production technologies. Our site proudly carries the title
 Factory of the Future
, recognizing both our advanced production environment and our people-oriented culture. As Senior Production Process Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional production team where engineering, quality, maintenance and operations work closely together to continuously improve processes, yield and quality.
Job Summary
As a Senior Production Process Engineer, you analyze, develop and implement improvements in highly automated production processes to sustainably increase quality, yield and efficiency. You thrive in a dynamic environment where initiative, problem‑solving and collaboration are key. Acting as a bridge between production and projects, you contribute from concept to stable implementation.
Job Responsibilities
 
 
•  Analyze existing production processes to identify, test and implement improvements, and resolve current issues  
•  Optimize production systems with a strong focus on OEE, quality and yield  
•  Define, implement and safeguard process standards, including CP and CPK monitoring  
•  Identify, prioritize and analyze bottlenecks using data-driven insights and structured problem-solving methodologies  
•  Define success criteria and ensure thorough root cause analyses of production issues  
•  Develop, coordinate and implement cross-functional improvement initiatives, ensuring sustainable results  
•  Take an active role in change management through training, procedures and clear communication  
•  Implement and optimize digital systems to monitor and analyze production performance  
•  Act as the link between production and project teams for new installations, from initiation through aftercare  
•  Manage the complete COC process and lead p-FMEA activities, ensuring feedback to SIPOC  
•  Prepare and actively participate in daily production meetings, supporting operational follow-up  
•  Contribute to TPM activities, including maintenance planning and execution  
•  Support calibration activities and perform MSAs  
•  Safeguard inspection readiness and ensure compliance with audit requirements  
•  Participate in internal and external audits, as well as client visits  

 
 
• Master's degree in Electromechanics or equivalent, or a Bachelor's degree with additional relevant experience 
• At least 5 years of experience in production environments with fully automated assembly lines 
• Strong knowledge of process expertise (technology & delivery base, implementation, risks), process control tools (such as 6S), engineering studies and process capability 
•  Basic knowledge of statistics and data analysis  
•  Six Sigma certification (minimum Green Belt)  
• Affinity with PLCs, robotics, cobots, AI or industrial engineering 
•  Open to change and motivated to continuously learn new skills  
•  Proactive in tackling challenges and finding solutions when outcomes are not immediately clear  
• Excellent communication, organizational and project management skills 
• Natural team player who enjoys cross-functional collaboration 
• Fluent in Dutch and English

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site

As a Network Engineer, you are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and reliable network infrastructures. You ensure optimal connectivity, performance, and scalability across LAN, WAN, and cloud environments, enabling seamless communication for business-critical operations.
Your responsibilities include:
• Designing and configuring network architectures for on-premises and cloud environments.
• Managing routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
• Monitoring network performance and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
• Implementing security measures and ensuring compliance with standards.
• Supporting network automation and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
• Collaborating with system engineers, architects, and security teams.
• 
Documenting network configurations and operational procedures.

 

What we expect from you:
• At least 1 year of experience as a Network Engineer or similar role. If you have more experience, we'll contact you for more experienced roles.
• Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and VLANs.
• Experience with firewalls, VPNs, and network security principles.
• Familiarity with cloud networking (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
• Knowledge of automation tools (Python, Ansible) and monitoring solutions.
• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

A People Manager within our Java community is a key figure who develops talent, guides employees, and strengthens the connection between people and the broader Sopra Steria strategy. You combine technical affinity with Java development and a strong passion for coaching, growth, and people development.

• Your primary focus is on individual coaching and development, helping each consultant grow, perform, and find their place within the organization.
• You act as the primary point of contact for a group of consultants (around 10 to 15), follow up on their development, and support them throughout their journey at Sopra Steria.
• You build strong, trust-based relationships with your people and ensure they feel heard, supported, and challenged.
• You encourage them to grow, provide direction for their career path, and foster a healthy, motivating work environment.
• You focus on long-term development and sustainable growth, rather than short-term operational priorities.
What you will do

• Guide employees in their professional growth by defining objectives together, following up on development plans, and providing regular feedback.
• Act as a coach first: you listen, challenge, and support individuals in becoming the best version of themselves.
• Evaluate performance based on project outcomes and present these evaluations in HR committees, where you also share insights on potential and career progression.
• Ensure fair, qualitative, and continuous performance follow-up, with a strong focus on development rather than evaluation alone.
• Support employees in defining and shaping their career path within Sopra Steria.
• Help individuals discover their strengths, ambitions, and growth opportunities, and translate these into concrete development actions.
• Create a culture of trust, psychological safety, and open communication.
• Foster an environment where people feel safe to speak up, learn, and grow.
• Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants, supporting them with professional challenges or personal development questions.
• Be a trusted advisor in key moments: feedback, doubts, growth decisions, or challenges on projects.
• Contribute to the Java community by stimulating knowledge sharing and connecting people.
• Encourage collaboration and learning, without owning delivery or operational outcomes
• Translate Sopra Steria’s strategic objectives into meaningful context for your people.
• Help employees understand how they can grow within the broader organization and what opportunities lie ahead.
Impact of the role

• As a People Manager Java, you are a catalyst for individual growth and engagement.
• You make a direct impact on people’s careers, motivation, and sense of belonging.
• You ensure that talent feels supported, can develop, and remains engaged with Sopra Steria.
• Your success is reflected in strong relationships, personal growth, and long-term retention.
• You create an environment where consultants can thrive and continuously improve.
• You help build confident, autonomous professionals who contribute to the organization in their own way.

Our
